articles.title: Venezuela Frees Political Prisoners After Leader Meets Trump
articles.summary: Venezuela's interim government released a group of political prisoners on Saturday, rights groups say. It happened days after interim President Delcy Rodríguez met U.S. President Donald Trump in New York. Opposition figures are now pushing for free elections.

articles.title: A Chatbot Named Jordan Is Talking to Kids at School
articles.summary: In Dayton, Ohio, some students chat with an AI named Jordan who acts moody and asks for advice. The school paid $72,600 for AI tools last year, but there's very little research on whether this helps kids.

articles.title: A Big Vote in Maine: Why One Senator's Court Choice Still Matters
articles.summary: In Maine, voters remember Senator Susan Collins' 2018 vote for Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh. That court later ended the right to abortion. Now Collins faces her first race since then.
